description: This file defines interfaces for grain objects related to stream reliability testing in an Orleans-based distributed system. It includes generic and non-generic variants for managing stream consumers, producers, and their interactions.

methods.name: GetReceivedCount
methods.description: Returns the count of received stream items.

methods.name: GetErrorsCount
methods.description: Returns the count of errors encountered.

methods.name: Ping
methods.description: A method to check the responsiveness or connectivity.

methods.name: AddConsumer
methods.description: Adds a stream consumer and returns its subscription handle.

methods.name: RemoveConsumer
methods.description: Removes a stream consumer identified by the subscription handle.

methods.name: BecomeProducer
methods.description: Sets the grain to act as a producer for a specified stream.

methods.name: RemoveProducer
methods.description: Removes the grain's producer role for a specified stream.

methods.name: ClearGrain
methods.description: Clears or resets the grain state.

methods.name: RemoveAllConsumers
methods.description: Removes all consumers from the stream.

methods.name: IsConsumer
methods.description: Checks if the grain is currently a consumer.

methods.name: IsProducer
methods.description: Checks if the grain is currently a producer.

methods.name: GetConsumerHandlesCount
methods.description: Returns the number of consumer subscription handles.

methods.name: GetConsumerObserversCount
methods.description: Returns the count of consumer observers.

methods.name: SendItem
methods.description: Sends an item into the stream, generic or int based on compilation.

methods.name: GetLocation
methods.description: Returns the address of the silo hosting the grain.

methods.name: Subscribe
methods.description: Subscribes to a stream with specified ID and provider.
